❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: 
1) Bad case coverage: Validators and tests do not pair
2) Purely based on guessing a mathematical formula
3) Zero to little programming elements
4) Lacks any key programming connections
Validators need to be similar to Tests.

❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: Basing the clash on guessing a formula is a bad idea for a Reverse mode clash. In addition, the task currently lacks any key programming elements such as lists, sets, dictionaries, string manipulation, loops, conditions…

Please include one or more programming elements so that the task is a programming one rather than a purely maths one.
